subject: Eversource Transmission Project and Public Access Governance
overview: The Council requested comprehensive mitigation and traffic plans for the Eversource Mystic-Woburn transmission project and addressed pedestrian and crossing guard safety. Members also debated public access television governance and producer requirements following a found Open Meeting Law violation.

items.title: Memorial Recognitions and Breast Cancer Awareness
items.summary: The Council observed a moment of silence for Las Vegas shooting victims and noted the start of Breast Cancer Awareness Month.

items.title: Infrastructure Repairs at 31 Wildwood Road
items.summary: The Council requested that the city engineer hold contractors accountable for repairing road and lawn damage caused by the Winthrop Street drainage project. The motion passed.

items.title: Zoning Restrictions for 186 Winthrop Street
items.summary: Members requested the Zoning Board of Appeals review and place restrictions on a bakery wholesaler's variance due to ongoing traffic, noise, and maintenance violations. The motion passed.

items.title: Enforcement Action at Main Street Gas Stations
items.summary: The Council requested that code enforcement investigate Jack's Gas Station for illegal vehicle storage and maintenance on residential streets and state property. The motion passed.

items.title: Citywide Stump Removal and Sidewalk Repair
items.summary: The Council requested specific stump removals and asked for a comprehensive progress report on all pending stump and sidewalk repairs. The motion passed.

items.title: Crosswalk Striping and Thermoplastic Standards
items.summary: Members requested repainting at Woburn Street and Wildwood Road while inquiring why the city does not utilize more durable thermoplastic materials for all crosswalks. The motion passed.

items.title: Memorial Resolutions
items.summary: The Council passed resolutions offering condolences to the families of Philip McGonigal and Al Canava.

items.title: Food Truck Approval and Permit Reviews
items.summary: The Council approved food trucks for the Fells 5K and scheduled a 90-day review for Annie's Pizzeria. Both motions passed.

items.title: Public Access Television Governance and CORI Policy
items.summary: A citizen report regarding an Open Meeting Law violation sparked a lengthy debate over CORI requirements for television producers and the governance of the multimedia center. The Council requested a copy of the Attorney General's decision and clarified that CORI checks are required by state law for those working in school buildings.

items.title: Safety at the Winthrop Street 'Rock Pile'
items.summary: The Council requested a report from the building department regarding a stalled construction site to address neighborhood safety and blight concerns. The motion passed.

items.title: Election Day Meeting Cancellation
items.summary: The Council voted to cancel the November 7 meeting due to the municipal election and discussed rescheduling the Halloween meeting. The motion passed.

items.title: Recognition of Chief Assessor Ed O'Neill
items.summary: The Council congratulated Ed O'Neill on his departure after 14 years of service to the city. The motion passed.

items.title: Eversource Mystic-Woburn Transmission Line Project
items.summary: Councilors demanded a public hearing and mitigation plans regarding an eight-mile underground electrical project slated to disrupt major city thoroughfares. The Council requested traffic management plans, residential mitigation, and firm construction dates before granting any permits.

items.title: Stalled Raised Crosswalk Pilot Program
items.summary: The Council requested an update on two long-promised raised crosswalks that remain uninstalled three years after the pilot program's approval. The motion passed.

items.title: Traffic Supervisor Safety and Communication
items.summary: Following an accident involving a crossing guard, the Council requested that the police provide traffic supervisors with radios and conduct enforcement stings to protect pedestrians. The motion passed.

items.title: Development Impact on School Enrollment
items.summary: The Council requested school committee data regarding how housing developments of 100 or more units affect student population growth. The motion passed.

items.title: Future Use of the Hagner Center
items.summary: Members requested a detailed evaluation and timeline for repurposing the vacant Hagner Center building. The motion passed.

items.title: Meeting Records and Adjournment
items.summary: The Council approved recent minutes and announced that future meetings will return to City Hall.
